basket.lore.uncommon: Packs a picnic so neatly that there is always room for one more sandwich. Nobody knows where the extra sandwiches come from.

box.lore.epic: Folded itself flat on moving day with all the plates still inside. The removal men are still apologising to the kitchen.

crate.lore.rare: Grows one extra slat every night, so nobody can get the lid back on. The bananas have stopped trying.
crate.lore.legendary: Was used as a boat, a stage and a dog bed in the same harbour in one day. The dog refused to give it back.

handbag.lore.legendary: Stopped a runaway bus with one swing of its strap. The driver said sorry and gave grandma a free ride home.

i_buckle.lore.epic: Tightened every belt at the school dinner by one notch, just as the pudding arrived. Nobody managed seconds.
i_buckle.lore.legendary: Held up a pair of trousers through a sneeze, a trampoline and a wedding conga. The trousers have written to say thank you.

i_hair_slide.lore.epic: Pinned the classroom curtains shut during the school play, and the whole show happened in the dark.
i_hair_slide.lore.legendary: Held back a sheepdog's fringe through a whole sheepdog trial. For the first time ever, the dog saw the sheep.

i_packet.lore.uncommon: Promises to be resealable and never reseals. Calls the rubber band cheating.
i_packet.lore.legendary: Crinkled so loudly during the school exam that the whole year group was sent home for the afternoon.

mailbox.lore.legendary: Swallowed the whole holiday post and delivered every card itself by morning. The postman got the day off.

x_cologne.lore.legendary: Was sprayed once at the school dance, and every pine tree in the park turned round to look.

x_perfume_bottle.lore.common: Spritzes itself every time somebody sneezes nearby. The sneezing has got much worse.
x_perfume_bottle.lore.rare: Makes anyone who sniffs it remember a holiday they never went on. Dad now insists he has been to Peru.
x_perfume_bottle.lore.legendary: Was dabbed on a scarecrow by mistake, and now the crows bring it flowers every morning.

suitcase.lore.legendary: Got lost at the airport and came back a year later with more passport stamps than the pilot.

treasure_chest.lore.legendary: Fooled a whole pirate crew into digging for a week. It had been sitting on the deck the entire time.

x_anklet.lore.common: Catches on every sandal strap, so you walk the whole beach with one shoe flapping.
x_anklet.lore.epic: Jingled down the pier so steadily that a hundred seagulls fell into step and marched behind it.
x_anklet.lore.legendary: Jingled the same tune for so long that the waves learned it. High tide now comes in humming.

x_awning.lore.legendary: Rolled out so far one windy morning that it shaded the bakery across the road. The two bakers now share their buns.

x_ballot_box.lore.legendary: Swallowed every vote slip and spat out one that said BIGGER SLIDE. The school built it by Monday.
x_ballot_box.lore.rare: Mixes up its slips when shaken, so every class vote ends in a tie with the teacher.

x_beach_umbrella.lore.epic: Opened so wide that it shaded the whole beach, and the ice-cream van had no customers by noon.
x_beach_umbrella.lore.legendary: Shaded a sandcastle so well that it lasted all summer, and a family of crabs moved in with a doormat.

x_bead.lore.legendary: Rolled under the sofa and came out the other side as a pearl. Grandma has been feeding the sofa beads ever since.

x_belt_bag.lore.epic: Was zipped round a bouncy castle by mistake, and the whole castle bounced off down the road.
x_belt_bag.lore.legendary: Was worn by a mountain goat for a whole summer and came back with a map of every secret path.

x_bum_bag.lore.rare: Swaps its contents with the nearest bag whenever its wearer sneezes. Dad once paid for lunch with a dog biscuit.
x_bum_bag.lore.epic: Spun round to the front on the roller coaster and sprayed sun cream over the whole queue.
x_bum_bag.lore.legendary: Flipped round to the front so stylishly that bum bags became fashionable again. Every grown-up on holiday blames it.

x_fanny_pack.lore.uncommon: Rides up so high when its wearer runs that it ends up as a chin rest.
x_fanny_pack.lore.epic: Popped its clip at the marathon start, and the runners chased its jelly babies all the way to the finish.
x_fanny_pack.lore.legendary: Was worn back to front for so long that its owner now runs backwards everywhere, faster than anyone forwards.

x_bento_box.lore.legendary: Kept the peas and the custard apart through a whole trampoline party. The toddler who tried to mix them has retired.

x_bracelet.lore.uncommon: Slides down to your elbow every time you put your hand up in class.
x_bracelet.lore.epic: Caught on the tablecloth at the summer fete and dragged forty cakes off in one go.
x_bracelet.lore.legendary: Jangled so loudly in the library that every book fell open at the exact page its reader had lost.

x_brooch.lore.common: Is always pinned on slightly crooked, so everyone tilts their head to talk to you.
x_brooch.lore.rare: Pins itself to the nearest coat at parties and goes home with a stranger. It has been to nine weddings uninvited.
x_brooch.lore.epic: Glinted from the balcony so brightly that the whole ballroom waltzed the wrong way round.
x_brooch.lore.legendary: Held a ship's sail together through a storm until the harbour came into view. The captain now wears it on his hat.

x_button.lore.rare: Undoes itself whenever its owner tells a fib. Uncle Pete has stopped telling fishing stories.
x_button.lore.epic: Shot off a tight waistcoat at the wedding and knocked the top tier off the cake.
x_button.lore.legendary: Held up the circus tent through a gale all on its own. When it finally popped, it landed in the ringmaster's hat.
x_button.names.legendary: Old Buttonwell of the Big Top

x_camera_bag.lore.epic: Unzipped itself on safari, and a monkey ran off with the camera and took better photos than anyone.
x_camera_bag.lore.legendary: Brought back a photo of a tiger from the jungle, and the tiger came back too. It wants copies.

x_cash_box.lore.epic: Snapped shut at the village fete and would only open for the tombola winner, who was a goat.
x_cash_box.lore.legendary: Lost its key on day one and has only ever opened when somebody sneezes. The fete treasurer carries a pepper pot.

x_donation_box.lore.common: Has a slot exactly one coin too narrow for the coin you are holding.
x_donation_box.lore.rare: Says thank you so sweetly for every coin that people come back just to hear it again.
x_donation_box.lore.legendary: Grew so heavy with coins that the shop counter sank into the cellar. The shopkeeper now serves from downstairs.

x_cereal_box.names.legendary: Admiral Flakewell of the Paddling Pool
x_cereal_box.lore.legendary: Poured one bowl so big that the family ate breakfast in a paddling pool. The milk came by tanker.

x_charm_bracelet.lore.legendary: Grew so many charms that it now chimes on the hour like a clock tower, and the whole street sets its watches by it.

x_cigar_box.lore.epic: Burst open in the school hall, and its marbles rolled under every chair during the headteacher's speech.
x_cigar_box.lore.legendary: Has hidden the same secret so well that even the box forgot it. It rattles sometimes, trying to remember.

x_clutch_bag.lore.uncommon: Snaps open at the quietest moment of every film, and the whole cinema turns round.
x_clutch_bag.lore.legendary: Was carried to the opera so often that it now hums the high notes, and the singers have asked it to keep quiet.

x_cocktail_umbrella.lore.epic: Popped open in the giant fruit punch bowl and paddled itself across the party like a tiny boat.
x_cocktail_umbrella.lore.legendary: Shaded one ice cube so well that it survived the whole summer, and now has its own little deckchair.

x_coin.lore.epic: Was flipped so high to start the football match that it came down a week later, on the other team.
x_coin.lore.legendary: Was found by a metal detector on the beach, then found it back. They now go treasure hunting together.

x_coins.lore.common: Always add up to exactly one penny less than the thing you want to buy.
x_coins.lore.legendary: Were dropped down the back of every sofa in town until they added up to a brand-new sofa. Nobody has sat on it.

x_coin_purse.lore.legendary: Snapped its clasp on a pickpocket so firmly that he had to buy everyone ice cream to get free.

x_compact_mirror.lore.legendary: Bounced a sunbeam all the way to the Moon, and the Moon flashed back. They now play every full moon.

x_cool_box.lore.uncommon: Freezes the sandwiches solid and leaves the ice lollies runny. Calls this teamwork.
x_cool_box.lore.epic: Opened its lid on the beach and blew out a winter wind, so everyone built snowmen in July.
x_cool_box.lore.legendary: Kept one ice lolly frozen for so long that it is now officially an antique. The museum wants a lick.

x_cooler.lore.epic: Rolled downhill at the campsite and cooled the whole lake so much that the ducks went skating.
x_cooler.lore.legendary: Was a seat, a table and a goalpost at the same campsite in one weekend, and kept the score cold.

x_ice_chest.lore.epic: Kept a fish so fresh that it woke up at the market and flopped back into the sea.
x_ice_chest.lore.legendary: Chilled a fisherman's lunch so hard that he used his sandwich as a hammer to fix the boat.

x_cufflink.lore.epic: Fell into the wedding soup, and every guest went fishing for it with their spoons.
x_cufflink.lore.legendary: Searched for its lost partner for forty years and found it in the very first drawer. Neither will talk about it.

x_cufflinks.lore.uncommon: Is always a matching pair until you put them on, and then one is suddenly gold and the other silver.
x_cufflinks.lore.epic: Fastened two dinner guests together by mistake, and they had to dance every dance as a pair.
x_cufflinks.lore.legendary: Fastened a magician's sleeves so tightly that every rabbit had to stay in.
x_cufflinks.names.legendary: The Twin Golds of the Magic Show

x_delivery_box.lore.uncommon: Is always the wrong size: one tiny pencil in a box the size of a fridge.
x_delivery_box.lore.epic: Rang every doorbell on the street looking for its owner, and the whole street came out in pyjamas.

x_parcel_box.lore.epic: Tumbled out of the van and bounced all the way to the right house, ringing the bell with its corner.
x_parcel_box.lore.legendary: Was posted to itself by mistake and has gone round in circles for ten years, collecting a stamp each lap.

x_diaper_bag.lore.epic: Burst open on the zoo trip, and a penguin waddled off wearing a nappy. The keepers say it suits him.
x_diaper_bag.lore.legendary: Packed for every emergency so well that it once produced a spare grandma for the school play.

x_duffel_bag.lore.epic: Swung off the coach roof and knocked down every tent at sports camp like dominoes.
x_duffel_bag.lore.legendary: Was packed for a weekend away and came back with a sailor, a parrot and a small rowing boat inside.

x_earring.lore.legendary: Dangled so gracefully that a hummingbird used it as a swing all summer and refused to fly south.

x_egg_carton.lore.uncommon: Holds twelve eggs and counts them every night. It always gets thirteen.
x_egg_carton.lore.legendary: Hatched a whole dozen chicks just by sitting very still, and now gets called Mum.

x_eyeliner.lore.uncommon: Draws a perfect line on one eye and a moustache on the other. Nobody knows how.
x_eyeliner.lore.epic: Drew such fierce eyebrows on the school play cast that the dragon refused to come on stage.
x_eyeliner.lore.legendary: Drew a line so straight across the playground that the school now uses it as the sports day finish line.
x_eyeliner.names.legendary: Madame Kohlette of the Finish Line

x_gift_bag.lore.legendary: Hid a present so deep in its tissue paper that the birthday girl found it on her next birthday.

x_gift_box.lore.legendary: Was wrapped so many times that unwrapping it took a whole year. Inside was a smaller box and a note: Next year.

x_golf_umbrella.lore.epic: Popped open in a gust on the fairway and carried the golfer over three holes. He landed in the hole on the last one.
x_golf_umbrella.lore.legendary: Kept the rain off a whole outdoor wedding, then turned inside out at the exact moment the photo was taken.

x_grocery_bag.lore.rare: Grows one shopping item heavier every time somebody says it is not far now.
x_grocery_bag.lore.epic: Split on the bus, and the onions rolled to the front and made the driver cry all the way to town.

x_gym_bag.lore.epic: Was tipped upside down at sports day, and seven lost PE kits from last year fell out, one still warm.
x_gym_bag.lore.legendary: Packed itself for PE every Tuesday for a whole term while its owner forgot. It got a merit badge.

x_jewelry_box.lore.common: Keeps one earring from every pair it is given, and wears them all inside at night.
x_jewelry_box.lore.epic: Wound its ballerina so tight that she spun out of the lid and danced round the whole town.
x_jewelry_box.lore.legendary: Locked itself during a burglary and played its tune so loudly that the burglar danced until the police arrived.

x_music_box.lore.legendary: Played a lullaby so sweet that a thunderstorm stopped to yawn and drifted off to sleep.

x_keepsake_box.lore.legendary: Reminded grandad where he buried his tin soldiers sixty years ago. They are still standing guard.

x_storage_box.lore.legendary: Sat in the loft so long that a family of bats made it their holiday home, with a little sign on the lid.
x_storage_box.lore.rare: Swaps its contents whenever the loft hatch shuts, so the summer box is always full of woolly hats.

x_tin_box.lore.rare: Pops so loudly when opened that the whole house comes running, hoping for biscuits.
x_tin_box.lore.legendary: Was used as a drum, a hat and a sledge in one snowy afternoon, and still had every biscuit inside.

x_shoebox.lore.legendary: Was turned into a hamster mansion with four floors and a lift. The hamster now refuses to leave.
x_shoebox.names.legendary: Lord Lidsworth of the Hamster Mansion

x_laptop_bag.lore.epic: Unzipped on the escalator and sent its pens, cables and sandwiches bouncing all the way to the bottom.
x_laptop_bag.lore.legendary: Carried a laptop on so many trains that the railway now saves it a window seat.

x_lip_balm.lore.epic: Melted on the coach dashboard, and the whole school trip smelled of cherries until the summer.
x_lip_balm.lore.legendary: Kissed a frog by mistake, and the frog said thank you very much for the cherry flavour.

x_lipstick.lore.epic: Wrote SORRY on the bathroom mirror so big that the whole family apologised to each other.
x_lipstick.lore.legendary: Gave a stone statue such a bright smile that the whole park smiled back. The pigeons are jealous.

x_locket.lore.legendary: Was opened at the family wedding and the photo inside waved. Nobody fainted, but the cake did fall over.

x_lunch_bag.lore.legendary: Kept a banana at the bottom so long that it became a new kind of fruit. The school named it after the bag.

x_lunch_box.lore.rare: Locks its clips at lunchtime and only opens once you have eaten the carrot sticks.
x_lunch_box.lore.legendary: Kept a sandwich so fresh that it was still edible on the last day of school, five years later. Nobody was brave enough.

x_makeup_bag.lore.legendary: Made up a whole circus so well that the lion was mistaken for the ringmaster for a week.

x_matchbox.lore.rare: Has a strip so scratchy that the cat sharpens its claws on it whenever it walks past.
x_matchbox.lore.legendary: Was hidden so high that the family needed a ladder, then a bigger ladder, then a cherry picker. It was in the drawer all along.

x_matches.lore.rare: Refuses to light for anyone under eighteen, and tells them off in a tiny squeaky voice.
x_matches.lore.epic: Spilled out of the box, and the whole family spent Sunday playing pick-up sticks with them. The cat won.
x_matches.lore.legendary: Stayed safely in its box on the top shelf for the whole camping trip, and the campfire sulked and lit itself.

x_messenger_bag.lore.epic: Flipped its flap open at full speed and delivered a whole bag of letters to the wrong street. The street wrote back.
x_messenger_bag.lore.legendary: Delivered a letter so fast that it arrived before it was written. The sender is still deciding what to say.

x_nail_polish.lore.legendary: Painted a zebra pink by mistake, and now every zebra at the zoo wants a turn.

x_nail_polish_bottle.lore.rare: Changes colour depending on who opens it. Dad always gets bright green.
x_nail_polish_bottle.lore.legendary: Painted the town clock hands bright pink, and now everyone is late in style.
x_nail_polish_bottle.names.legendary: Madame Lacquer of the Town Clock

x_necklace.lore.rare: Wraps itself round the door handle every time its wearer leaves, so nobody gets out on time.

x_paper_bag.lore.epic: Blew down the high street in a gust and wrapped itself round the baker's head. He baked blind and made his best loaf ever.
x_paper_bag.lore.legendary: Has been folded, flattened and reused so many times that it is now a map of the whole town.

x_parasol_stand.lore.uncommon: Leaks sand onto the patio all summer until there is a tiny beach under the table.
x_parasol_stand.lore.epic: Was too heavy to move, so the garden party moved round it all afternoon like water round a rock.
x_parasol_stand.lore.legendary: Stayed put so stubbornly that the house was rebuilt around it. It now lives in the kitchen, holding up nothing.

x_patio_umbrella.lore.rare: Spins in the breeze so fast that it flings rainwater over the fence next door, every single time.
x_patio_umbrella.lore.epic: Spun so hard at the barbecue that every sausage flew off the grill into the paddling pool next door.
x_patio_umbrella.lore.legendary: Stayed open so long one summer that it got a tan line on its own pole.

x_pendant.lore.rare: Swings like a pendulum at dinner and points at whoever ate the last biscuit.
x_pendant.lore.legendary: Swung so steadily in front of a grumpy goose that the goose fell asleep and has been friendly ever since.

x_pipe.lore.legendary: Blew a bubble so big that grandad floated inside it to the end of the garden and back, still in his slippers.

x_pizza_box.lore.legendary: Delivered a pizza so fast that it arrived before anyone was hungry, and waited politely on the doorstep.

x_plastic_container.lore.legendary: Finally found its matching lid after twenty years. It had been on its head the whole time.

x_tupperware.lore.uncommon: Hides at the back of the fridge until its leftovers grow a fluffy green coat.
x_tupperware.lore.rare: Seals so tightly that a sandwich inside stayed fresh all holiday and came back with opinions.
x_tupperware.lore.epic: Burped open in the fridge, and the smell of curry woke the whole street.
x_tupperware.lore.legendary: Was sealed so tight that nobody has opened it for thirty years. The family argue about what is inside every birthday.

x_poker_chip.lore.rare: Rolls off the table and under the sofa every time someone is about to win.
x_poker_chip.lore.legendary: Was lost under the sofa for ten years and came out as a coaster. It now refuses to be a chip.

x_ring.lore.uncommon: Turns your finger green every time you wear it, and calls this a special edition.

x_wedding_ring.lore.uncommon: Gets stuck after a big dinner and needs butter, soap and two aunties to come off.
x_wedding_ring.lore.legendary: Went missing in the vegetable patch and turned up forty years later inside a potato at the harvest supper.

x_sequin.lore.epic: Caught the disco ball light and bounced a thousand rainbows round the hall, and everyone danced into the walls.
x_sequin.lore.legendary: Stuck to a pigeon, which became the most famous dancer in the park.

x_sewing_box.lore.common: Hides the scissors under the thread, the thread under the buttons, and the buttons nowhere.
x_sewing_box.lore.epic: Stitched the school play costumes together by mistake, and the whole cast walked on as one long dragon.
x_sewing_box.lore.legendary: Darned one sock so many times that no sock is left, only darning. It is still the warmest sock in the house.

x_smart_ring.lore.common: Buzzes so gently and so often that you think your finger has the hiccups.
x_smart_ring.lore.epic: Mistook a whole dance class for a marathon and buzzed CONGRATULATIONS so hard that the dancers sat down.
x_smart_ring.lore.legendary: Counted so many steps that it demanded its own pair of trainers. It now goes jogging without its owner.

x_sunshade.lore.uncommon: Sticks to the windscreen with its suckers and takes a bit of the dashboard with it.
x_sunshade.lore.epic: Sprang open in the car park and flipped onto the next car, which drove off wearing it.
x_sunshade.lore.legendary: Folded back into its bag on the very first try, and the whole family gave it a round of applause.

x_tackle_box.lore.rare: Hides the best lure in the bottom drawer until the fish have all gone home.
x_tackle_box.lore.legendary: Caught a fish all by itself while grandad napped, and the fish asked to be in the photo.

x_tissue_box.lore.epic: Sneezed back at the whole class, and its tissues flew round the room like snow.
x_tissue_box.lore.legendary: Caught a sneeze so big that the whole box floated off like a hot-air balloon.

x_toiletry_bag.lore.rare: Packs itself with tiny hotel soaps whenever nobody is looking. The family owns four hundred.
x_toiletry_bag.lore.legendary: Was left behind in a hotel and came home a week later in a taxi, paid for in tiny soaps.

x_tool_bag.lore.rare: Swallows any tool you put down for one second, and hands it back after you have bought a new one.
x_tool_bag.lore.epic: Fixed every squeak in the house in one weekend, and now nobody can hear anyone coming.
x_tool_bag.lore.legendary: Built a whole treehouse by itself while the builder had a cup of tea. It even fitted a doorbell.
